translations.title: Concert Queue Guide Malaysia: Ticket, Phone Backup and Gear Checks
translations.metaTitle: Concert Queue Guide Malaysia: Ticket, Phone Backup and Gear Checks
translations.metaDescription: A cautious Malaysia concert-queue checklist: follow organiser rules, protect ticket access, and understand the evidence limits on listed fans, power banks and SIMs.
translations.quickAnswer: For a Malaysia concert queue, follow the event organiser's current instructions first, then reduce avoidable ticket and phone-access problems. Keep the official ticket route, account access, order reference and a charged phone ready. This guide lists a documented GOOJODOQ GFS001 option and marketplace leads, but does not promise venue treatment, phone charging results, cooling, or mobile signal performance.
keyTakeaways: The organiser's latest event page, ticket issuer notice and venue rules override every generic queue tip.
Keep ticket-account access, order reference, recovery email or number and official event notices available before leaving.
GFS001 has documented manufacturer-stated specifications; the unnamed mini fan and UGREEN listing do not support a full technical comparison.
Crowded-event mobile service can be uncertain. Do not make a SIM purchase assuming reliable data or calls at a particular queue.

sections.sectionTitle: Start with the event's own queue rules
sections.sectionBody: Do not use a generic article to decide when or where to queue. Check the organiser's latest official event page, ticket issuer messages and venue notice for the stated arrival window, queue process, prohibited items, identification requirements and any changes. Save the official links and read updates again on the event day. The organiser's current instructions control.

sections.sectionTitle: Build a ticket and phone-access backup
sections.sectionBody: Before travel, sign in to the official ticket account on the phone you intend to carry and confirm you can reach the event record. Keep the order reference, purchaser email, account-recovery route and official support contact somewhere you can access without guessing. If the ticket issuer explicitly provides an offline ticket feature or explicitly permits a saved copy, follow its instructions; do not assume that a screenshot, printout or another phone will be accepted. A companion who can contact you is a useful practical fallback, but not a substitute for the organiser's instructions.

sections.sectionTitle: Treat power as a planning task, not a product promise
sections.sectionBody: Start with your own phone, cable and a charged setup. The supplied Shopee listing identifies a UGREEN Magnetic Wireless 10000mAh Power Bank, but supplies no model number or enough specifications to verify charging wattage, Qi2 support, ports, dimensions or phone compatibility. It is a listing to inspect, not evidence that it will charge your phone, fit your case or meet an event's item rules. Check the exact listing, included items, return terms and organiser restrictions before paying or packing it.

sections.sectionTitle: What is documented for GOOJODOQ GFS001
sections.sectionBody: GOOJODOQ's official product page and official GFS001 manual identify a 4.5W, 4000mAh, Type-C rechargeable handheld fan with 100 adjustable levels and a digital display. The manual states 1.93 to 8.23 hours of operation and about 2.5 hours charging. Treat those as manufacturer-stated figures, not a promise for a chosen setting or event day. The official page and manual conflict on dimensions and weight, so this draft omits both. We did not test airflow, cooling, noise, durability, battery behaviour or comfort. Confirm whether any fan is permitted by the relevant organiser before taking it.

sections.sectionTitle: Why the mini fan and UGREEN are listing-only leads
sections.sectionBody: The supplied GOOJODOQ Mini High Speed Handheld Fan with Display listing identifies a mini handheld fan with a display, but no matching model number was supplied. Battery capacity, speed count, operating time, charging time, weight and noise therefore remain unverified. The UGREEN listing has the same evidence problem at the model/specification level. Neither marketplace listing proves a fixed price, stock position, seller authorisation, included accessories, warranty result or suitability for an event. Use the active links only to inspect the current offer.

sections.sectionTitle: Do not buy a SIM on an assumption about concert congestion
sections.sectionBody: Large gatherings may create uncertain mobile conditions, and this guide does not claim that any carrier, MVNO, plan or hotspot will work reliably at a particular concert queue. Halo's terms say Tune Talk provides the mobile service as a co-branded product with Winner Venture and that a registered SIM must be activated in Malaysia within 14 days by reload, call or SMS. The text terms do not publish a numerical hotspot pool, post-quota speed or FUP threshold for the image-led EPIK cards. Verify the exact plan, registration and activation requirements directly with the operator; do not infer them from a listing title or starter-SIM price.

sections.sectionTitle: Malaysia checkout and packing checks
sections.sectionBody: For any marketplace item, confirm the exact model or variation, final payable amount, seller identity, delivery timing, included items, returns and current listing terms. Separately recheck the organiser's current rules before packing anything. sections.sectionTitle: 建立票务和手机访问备用方案
sections.sectionBody: 出发前，在准备携带的手机上登录官方票务账户，并确认可以打开活动记录。把订单编号、购票邮箱、账户恢复方式和官方客服联系方式放在无需猜测即可取得的位置。若票务平台明确提供离线票务功能或明确允许保存副本，请依照其指示；不要假设截图、打印件或另一部手机会被接受。可以联系到的同行者是实用备用方案，但不能替代主办方指示。

sections.sectionTitle: 把手机电量当作计划，不要当作产品承诺
sections.sectionBody: 先准备自己的手机、线材和已充电的组合。所提供的 Shopee 商品页标示 UGREEN Magnetic Wireless 10000mAh Power Bank，但没有型号或足够规格可核实充电功率、Qi2、接口、尺寸或手机兼容性。它只是值得查看的商品页，不代表一定能为你的手机充电、适合你的手机壳或符合活动物品规则。购买或携带前，请核对准确商品页、随附物品、退货条款和主办方限制。

sections.sectionTitle: 不要基于演唱会拥堵假设购买 SIM 卡
sections.sectionBody: 大型活动的移动网络状况可能不确定，本文不声称任何电信商、MVNO、配套或热点会在某个演唱会队伍中可靠可用。Halo 条款说明移动服务由 Tune Talk 以与 Winner Venture 联名的方式提供；已注册 SIM 必须在马来西亚于 14 天内通过充值、通话或短信激活。文字条款没有为图片式 EPIK 卡公布数值热点额度、限额后速度或 FUP 门槛。请直接向运营商确认准确配套、注册和激活要求。

pageConfig.primaryKeyword: how to choose prepaid data SIM Malaysia
pageConfig.disclosure: This page contains affiliate links. If you buy through them, we may earn a commission at no extra cost to you. Inclusion and editorial guidance are based on documented buyer fit and primary operator evidence, not commission rate. A marketplace SIM price is not proof that an active data plan is included.

translations.title: How to Choose a Prepaid Data SIM in Malaysia: Start with Terms, Not the Starter Price
translations.metaTitle: How to Choose a Prepaid Data SIM in Malaysia
translations.metaDescription: Choose a Malaysia prepaid data SIM by checking operator relationship, quota, hotspot, FUP, validity, KYC and activation rules before a Shopee checkout.
translations.quickAnswer: Choose a prepaid SIM by matching documented terms to how you use data, not by the starter-card price. Eastel is an MVNO using U Mobile infrastructure and publishes EZ plan allowances plus a 1,000-minute monthly voice FUP. BeONE says it is powered by Maxis and publishes separate hotspot limits and 512kbps after main quota. Halo is a Tune Talk and Winner Venture co-brand with a 14-day activation requirement and 45-day incoming-only grace period. None is a universal coverage or speed winner from these documents, and a low listing price does not prove a plan is included.
keyTakeaways: Separate the starter-SIM listing price from the cost, quota and validity of the data plan you will actually activate.
Compare the main quota, hotspot pool, post-quota treatment and voice FUP before comparing headline data numbers.
Check registration, activation and number-validity rules before paying, especially if you will not activate the SIM immediately.

sections.sectionTitle: Use a term-first decision order
sections.sectionBody: Use this order: confirm the exact marketplace variant; identify the operator relationship; compare active-plan quota and validity; check hotspot and post-quota treatment; then confirm registration and activation. This avoids the common mistake of treating a RM-priced starter card as a ready-to-use monthly package. The supplied listings are offers to check, not a ranking: [Eastel listing](https://s.shopee.com.my/4fuWnhDoL3), [BeONE listing](https://s.shopee.com.my/5LADazr6Y4), and [Halo listing](https://s.shopee.com.my/8KnpAZIkyx).

sections.sectionTitle: Operator relationship helps you find evidence, not predict performance
sections.sectionBody: Eastel states that it is an MVNO using U Mobile network infrastructure and directs users to U Mobile's coverage map. BeONE describes its service as powered by Maxis. Halo's subscription terms say the mobile service is supplied by Tune Talk as a co-branded product with Winner Venture. Those statements tell you where to start a coverage and terms check. They do not establish identical network priority, indoor reception, congestion behaviour, speed, gaming latency or reliability versus any host operator retail plan. No hands-on controlled network test was performed, so this guide does not declare a coverage or speed winner.

sections.sectionTitle: Compare usable data, hotspot and what happens after quota
sections.sectionBody: Eastel publishes EZ plan allowances, including EZ35 with 200GB and 100GB hotspot for 30 days, while EZ50, EZ68 and EZ98 are described as full-hotspot monthly plans. Its monthly plans state a 1,000-minute voice FUP; its wider data FUP permits measures such as speed reduction or hotspot restriction without one universal published post-quota speed. BeONE's published FUP is easier to model: it identifies separate main-data and hotspot pools, states 512kbps after main quota, and says tethering may be restricted once the separate hotspot allowance is exhausted. Halo's current EPIK plan details are largely image-based in the reviewed material; confirm the exact card, hotspot terms and post-quota treatment in written current terms or the official app before relying on it.

sections.sectionTitle: Plan validity and number validity are different clocks
sections.sectionBody: A large quota is not useful if the plan expires before your trip, study period or work cycle ends, and a valid plan is not the same thing as a valid phone number. Eastel's terms describe an initially active MSISDN period followed by a 90-day barred state if there is no reload. Halo requires a registered SIM to be activated in Malaysia within 14 days through reload, a call or a message. After Halo reload validity expires, its terms describe a 45-day grace period for incoming calls and SMS only. Choose the service whose activation and reload rhythm you can realistically meet, rather than buying a card early and assuming it can wait unused.

sections.sectionTitle: Checkout checklist and related Launcher comparison

Halo is a Tune Talk co-brand and should be checked through its official support channels.

faqItems.answer: A registered Halo SIM must be activated in Malaysia within 14 days by reload, call or message. Its terms also describe a 45-day incoming-only grace period after reload validity ends. Buy only when you can complete registration and activation on time.

sections.sectionTitle: Bandingkan data boleh guna, hotspot dan keadaan selepas kuota

Terma juga menerangkan grace period 45 hari untuk panggilan dan SMS masuk selepas tempoh sah reload tamat. Beli hanya jika anda boleh mendaftar dan mengaktifkannya tepat pada masa.

sections.sectionTitle: 比较真正可用的数据、热点和用完后处理
sections.sectionBody: Eastel 公布 EZ 套餐额度，包括 EZ35 的 200GB、100GB 热点和 30 天有效期；EZ50、EZ68、EZ98 被描述为 full-hotspot 月费套餐。其月费套餐列出每月 1,000 分钟通话 FUP，而一般数据 FUP 可以采取降速或限制热点等措施，但没有统一公开的用完后固定速度。BeONE 的公开 FUP 更容易判断：主数据和热点分别计算，主数据用完后为 512kbps，独立热点额度用完后可能限制 tethering。所查 Halo EPIK 当前资料多为图片；不要只凭卡图判断，应在书面现行条款或官方 App 确认具体卡、热点和用完后规则。

sections.sectionBody: 如果套餐在旅行、学习或工作周期结束前失效，大数据量也没有意义；套餐仍有效也不等于手机号码仍有效。Eastel 条款说明号码先处于活跃状态，未充值后会进入 90 天 barred 状态。Halo 要求已注册 SIM 在马来西亚 14 天内通过充值、通话或短信激活。Halo 充值有效期结束后，条款说明有 45 天仅可接听电话及接收短信的宽限期。应选择你能按时完成激活和充值的服务，而不是提早买卡后假设可长期闲置。

translations.title: Malaysia Mobile Hotspot Backup Guide: Eastel vs BeONE vs Halo
translations.metaTitle: Malaysia Mobile Hotspot Backup: Eastel vs BeONE vs Halo
translations.metaDescription: Compare documented Eastel, BeONE and Halo plan, hotspot, FUP and validity rules for occasional mobile hotspot backup in Malaysia. Check the live plan before buying.
translations.disclosure: Some links on this page may be affiliate links. If you buy through them, we may earn a commission at no extra cost to you. We only include products that fit the comparison criteria on this page.
translations.quickAnswer: For occasional hotspot backup, choose only after matching the plan to your backup window. Eastel documents plan-level hotspot allowances, including EZ35 at 100GB hotspot for 30 days. BeONE documents separate hotspot pools and a 512kbps post-main-quota rule on listed plans. Halo's reviewed text terms do not publish a comparable numerical hotspot pool or post-quota speed. None should be treated as a promise of reliable coverage or a replacement for home broadband.
keyTakeaways: Compare a named active plan, not the low starter-SIM listing price.
Eastel and BeONE publish numerical hotspot rules for selected plans; Halo needs plan-specific written confirmation.
Plan validity, account validity and data exhaustion rules are separate checks.
Host-network references and coverage maps are indications only, not performance guarantees.

sections.sectionTitle: What this guide is and is not
sections.sectionBody: This is a documentation-led guide to occasional mobile hotspot backup: for example, a temporary connection while you wait for a fixed-line issue to be resolved. It does not rate Eastel, BeONE or Halo for coverage, speed, latency, gaming, video calls, indoor reception or reliability. Mobile service can depend on location, congestion, device, plan treatment and local conditions. Do not buy any of these SIMs on the assumption that it will replace home broadband.

sections.sectionTitle: Documented plan and hotspot comparison
sections.sectionBody: Eastel publishes EZ15 at RM15 for 30GB over 15 days, EZ35 at RM35 for 200GB with 100GB hotspot over 30 days, and EZ50, EZ68 and EZ98 monthly plans described as full hotspot with 30-day validity. BeONE's published FUP table lists 100GB main data plus 10GB hotspot for ULTRA plus 25, and 200GB plus 50GB hotspot for ULTRA plus 35; it also lists daily 3GB and weekly 15GB options. Halo shows EPIK plan cards, but the reviewed text subscription terms do not give a comparable numerical hotspot pool, post-quota speed or FUP threshold. Recheck the named plan in the official app or plan page before payment.

sections.sectionTitle: Eastel: documented allowance and monthly-plan rule
sections.sectionBody: Eastel says it is an MVNO using U Mobile infrastructure. For a defined 30-day hotspot allowance, its published EZ35 terms are the clearest listed example: 200GB main data and 100GB hotspot. EZ50, EZ68 and EZ98 are described as full-hotspot monthly plans, but the current plan page remains the source of truth. Eastel states that only one EZ35, EZ50, EZ68 or EZ98 monthly plan may be active at a time; purchasing another forfeits remaining benefits of the prior monthly plan. Its general FUP permits measures such as speed reduction, caps, hotspot restrictions, suspension or termination for excessive or abusive use, without one universal published post-quota speed.

sections.sectionTitle: BeONE: separate hotspot pool and stated post-quota treatment
sections.sectionBody: BeONE describes its service as powered by Maxis; that statement does not establish identical retail-plan priority, coverage or performance. Its FUP table is useful for buyers who need a written hotspot number: ULTRA plus 25 lists 100GB main data and 10GB hotspot, while ULTRA plus 35 lists 200GB main data and 50GB hotspot. The table states 512kbps after the main quota is exhausted, and says tethering may be restricted once the separate hotspot pool is exhausted. Its unlimited-call FUP is 2,000 minutes per month, followed by standard pay-per-use charges. Confirm the exact plan label because plan menus can change.

sections.sectionTitle: Halo: activation and validity are clearer than hotspot numbers
sections.sectionBody: Halo's terms state that Tune Talk supplies the mobile service as a co-branded product with Winner Venture. A registered SIM must be activated in Malaysia within 14 days through reload, a call or an SMS. The reviewed text terms say service is subject to fair use and may be moderated, charged at prevailing rates, suspended or terminated for excessive use, but do not publish a numerical FUP threshold, hotspot pool or post-quota speed for the image-led EPIK cards. Treat a listing title such as full hotspot, and the recorded RM4.96 starter price, as something to verify rather than proof of a usable backup allowance. After reload validity ends, Halo documents a 45-day incoming-call-and-SMS-only grace period.

sections.sectionTitle: Activation, validity and checkout checklist
sections.sectionBody: Registration is not optional. Eastel requires registration and successful verification before activation and prohibits pre-activated SIMs. BeONE requires identity verification and SIM registration before activation; its reviewed public general terms do not list every accepted document or onboarding step, so confirm in the official app or with support. Halo requires Malaysian citizens to use NRIC, permits up to five SIMs per NRIC or passport, and has the 14-day Malaysia activation rule. Check whether you are buying a blank starter SIM or a bundled named plan; then confirm reload requirements, data and hotspot pools, plan validity, account validity, renewal, FUP treatment, seller identity and refund restrictions after registration.

sections.sectionTitle: Related Launcher guides
sections.sectionBody: Before checkout, use our [Malaysia prepaid SIM comparison](/en/blog/eastel-vs-beone-vs-halo-prepaid-sim-malaysia) for the broader operator-rule comparison and the [new prepaid SIM checklist](/en/blog/new-sim-checklist-guide-malaysia) for registration and listing checks. For a different travel-use decision, see the [airport layover guide](/en/blog/airport-layover-guide-malaysia). These links are contextual research aids, not coverage recommendations.

faqItems.question: Which has the clearest documented hotspot allowance?
faqItems.answer: Among the reviewed documents, Eastel and BeONE publish plan-level numerical hotspot allowances. Eastel lists 100GB hotspot on EZ35, while BeONE lists 10GB on ULTRA plus 25 and 50GB on ULTRA plus 35. Halo's reviewed text terms do not publish a comparable number for EPIK cards.

faqItems.question: Can I use one of these as home broadband backup?
faqItems.answer: Use it only as a temporary mobile-data option if the live plan rules fit your needs. This guide makes no claim that any option is reliable at your address or suitable as a replacement for home broadband. Check hotspot allowance, FUP, local signal and your own device needs first.

faqItems.question: What happens after the data quota is used?
faqItems.answer: BeONE states 512kbps after main data is exhausted on its published FUP table and may restrict tethering after the hotspot pool is used. Eastel's general FUP allows various measures but does not state one universal post-quota speed. Halo's reviewed text terms do not state a comparable numerical post-quota speed.

faqItems.question: Does a low Shopee SIM price include a data plan?
faqItems.answer: Not necessarily. The recorded listing snapshots were RM9.96 for Eastel, RM0.10 for BeONE and RM4.96 for Halo on 11 July 2026. They are marketplace listing prices, not proof of an included reload, active plan, data quota or hotspot allowance.

translations.body:
## Affiliate disclosure
Some links on this page may be affiliate links. If you buy through them, we may earn a commission at no extra cost to you. We only include products that fit the comparison criteria on this page.

## Evidence limits
This is a documentation comparison of published plan, hotspot, fair-use, activation and validity rules. We did not conduct hands-on network testing and do not claim reliable coverage, speed, latency, indoor signal, performance or home-broadband replacement suitability.

## Bottom line
Choose a named plan only after confirming its hotspot pool, validity and post-quota rule. Do not infer benefits from a starter-SIM price or a marketplace title.

translations.title: Panduan Sandaran Hotspot Mudah Alih Malaysia: Eastel vs BeONE vs Halo
translations.metaTitle: Sandaran Hotspot Malaysia: Eastel vs BeONE vs Halo
translations.metaDescription: Bandingkan peraturan pelan, hotspot, FUP dan tempoh sah Eastel, BeONE dan Halo yang diterbitkan untuk sandaran hotspot mudah alih di Malaysia.
translations.disclosure: Sesetengah pautan di halaman ini mungkin pautan affiliate. Jika anda membeli melalui pautan tersebut, kami mungkin menerima komisen tanpa kos tambahan kepada anda. Kami hanya menyenaraikan produk yang sesuai dengan kriteria perbandingan halaman ini.
translations.quickAnswer: Untuk sandaran hotspot sekali-sekala, padankan pelan dengan tempoh sandaran yang diperlukan. Eastel menerbitkan elaun hotspot mengikut pelan, termasuk EZ35 dengan hotspot 100GB selama 30 hari. BeONE menerbitkan kuota hotspot berasingan dan peraturan 512kbps selepas kuota data utama bagi pelan yang disenaraikan. Terma teks Halo yang disemak tidak menerbitkan kuota hotspot atau kelajuan selepas kuota yang setara. Tiada satu pun patut dianggap jaminan liputan atau pengganti broadband rumah.
keyTakeaways: Bandingkan pelan aktif bernama, bukan harga starter SIM.
Eastel dan BeONE menerbitkan peraturan hotspot bernombor untuk pelan tertentu; Halo perlukan pengesahan bertulis mengikut pelan.
Tempoh sah pelan, tempoh sah akaun dan peraturan selepas kuota ialah semakan berasingan.
Rujukan rangkaian hos atau peta liputan hanya petunjuk, bukan jaminan prestasi.

sections.sectionTitle: Skop panduan ini
sections.sectionBody: Ini ialah panduan berasaskan dokumen untuk sandaran hotspot mudah alih sekali-sekala, contohnya sambungan sementara ketika isu talian tetap sedang diselesaikan. Ia tidak menilai Eastel, BeONE atau Halo untuk liputan, kelajuan, latency, gaming, panggilan video, signal dalam bangunan atau kebolehpercayaan. Servis mudah alih bergantung pada lokasi, kesesakan, peranti, layanan pelan dan keadaan setempat. Jangan beli SIM ini dengan andaian ia menggantikan broadband rumah.

sections.sectionTitle: Perbandingan pelan dan hotspot yang didokumenkan
sections.sectionBody: Eastel menerbitkan EZ15 RM15 dengan 30GB selama 15 hari, EZ35 RM35 dengan 200GB serta hotspot 100GB selama 30 hari, dan EZ50, EZ68 serta EZ98 yang dinyatakan full hotspot selama 30 hari. Jadual FUP BeONE menyenaraikan ULTRA plus 25 dengan 100GB data utama dan hotspot 10GB, serta ULTRA plus 35 dengan 200GB dan hotspot 50GB; turut disenaraikan pilihan 3GB harian dan 15GB mingguan. Kad EPIK Halo dipaparkan sebagai imej, tetapi terma teks yang disemak tidak memberi kuota hotspot, kelajuan selepas kuota atau ambang FUP yang setara. Semak pelan bernama dalam aplikasi atau halaman rasmi sebelum membayar.

sections.sectionTitle: Eastel: elaun diterbitkan dan peraturan pelan bulanan
sections.sectionBody: Eastel menyatakan ia MVNO menggunakan infrastruktur U Mobile. Untuk elaun hotspot 30 hari yang jelas, EZ35 menerbitkan 200GB data utama dan 100GB hotspot. EZ50, EZ68 dan EZ98 dinyatakan sebagai pelan bulanan full hotspot, tetapi halaman pelan semasa ialah sumber utama. Eastel menyatakan hanya satu EZ35, EZ50, EZ68 atau EZ98 boleh aktif pada satu masa; membeli pelan bulanan baharu melucutkan baki manfaat pelan terdahulu. FUP data am membenarkan pengurangan kelajuan, had, sekatan hotspot, penggantungan atau penamatan untuk penggunaan berlebihan atau menyalah guna, tanpa satu kelajuan selepas kuota yang tetap.

sections.sectionTitle: BeONE: kuota hotspot berasingan dan layanan selepas kuota
sections.sectionBody: BeONE menyatakan perkhidmatan dikuasakan Maxis; ini tidak membuktikan prioriti, liputan atau prestasi sama seperti pelan runcit Maxis. Jadual FUP memberi nombor berguna: ULTRA plus 25 mempunyai 100GB data utama dan 10GB hotspot, manakala ULTRA plus 35 mempunyai 200GB serta 50GB hotspot. Jadual itu menyatakan 512kbps selepas kuota utama habis dan tethering mungkin disekat apabila kuota hotspot berasingan habis. FUP panggilan unlimited ialah 2,000 minit sebulan sebelum kadar pay-per-use standard. Sahkan label pelan tepat kerana menu pelan boleh berubah.

sections.sectionTitle: Halo: pengaktifan dan tempoh sah lebih jelas daripada angka hotspot
sections.sectionBody: Terma Halo menyatakan Tune Talk membekalkan servis mudah alih sebagai produk berjenama bersama Winner Venture. SIM berdaftar mesti diaktifkan di Malaysia dalam 14 hari melalui reload, panggilan atau SMS. Terma teks yang disemak menyatakan servis tertakluk kepada fair use dan boleh disederhanakan, dicaj mengikut kadar semasa, digantung atau ditamatkan bagi penggunaan berlebihan, tetapi tiada kuota hotspot, ambang FUP atau kelajuan selepas kuota bernombor untuk kad EPIK. Jangan anggap tajuk listing full hotspot atau harga starter RM4.96 sebagai bukti elaun sandaran. Selepas tempoh sah reload tamat, Halo mendokumenkan tempoh grace 45 hari untuk panggilan dan SMS masuk sahaja.

sections.sectionTitle: Pengaktifan, tempoh sah dan semakan checkout
sections.sectionBody: Pendaftaran diperlukan. Eastel memerlukan pendaftaran dan pengesahan berjaya sebelum aktif serta melarang SIM pre-activated. BeONE memerlukan pengesahan identiti dan pendaftaran sebelum aktif; terma am awam yang disemak tidak memperincikan semua dokumen atau langkah onboarding, jadi sahkan dalam aplikasi atau dengan sokongan rasmi. Halo menggunakan NRIC untuk rakyat Malaysia, membenarkan sehingga lima SIM bagi satu NRIC atau pasport, dan mempunyai peraturan aktif 14 hari. Sahkan sama ada anda membeli starter SIM kosong atau pelan bernama; kemudian semak reload, kuota data dan hotspot, tempoh sah pelan dan akaun, pembaharuan, FUP, penjual dan sekatan refund selepas pendaftaran.

sections.sectionTitle: Panduan Launcher berkaitan
sections.sectionBody: Sebelum checkout, baca [perbandingan SIM prabayar Malaysia](/my/blog/eastel-vs-beone-vs-halo-prepaid-sim-malaysia-my) untuk peraturan operator yang lebih luas dan [senarai semak SIM prabayar baharu](/my/blog/new-sim-checklist-guide-malaysia-my) untuk semakan pendaftaran serta listing. Untuk keputusan penggunaan travel yang berbeza, lihat [panduan tempoh menunggu lapangan terbang](/my/blog/airport-layover-guide-malaysia-my). Pautan ini ialah bantuan penyelidikan, bukan cadangan liputan.

faqItems.question: Yang mana mempunyai elaun hotspot paling jelas dalam dokumen?
faqItems.answer: Daripada dokumen yang disemak, Eastel dan BeONE menerbitkan elaun hotspot bernombor mengikut pelan. Eastel menyenaraikan hotspot 100GB pada EZ35; BeONE menyenaraikan 10GB pada ULTRA plus 25 dan 50GB pada ULTRA plus 35. Terma teks Halo tidak menerbitkan nombor setara untuk EPIK.

faqItems.question: Bolehkah SIM ini digunakan sebagai sandaran broadband rumah?
faqItems.answer: Gunakan hanya sebagai pilihan data mudah alih sementara jika peraturan pelan live sesuai dengan keperluan anda. Panduan ini tidak mendakwa mana-mana pilihan boleh dipercayai di alamat anda atau sesuai menggantikan broadband rumah. Semak hotspot, FUP, signal tempatan dan peranti anda dahulu.

faqItems.question: Apa berlaku selepas kuota data habis?
faqItems.answer: BeONE menyatakan 512kbps selepas data utama habis dan mungkin menyekat tethering selepas kuota hotspot digunakan. FUP am Eastel membenarkan beberapa tindakan tetapi tidak menyatakan satu kelajuan selepas kuota yang universal. Terma teks Halo yang disemak tidak menyatakan kelajuan selepas kuota yang setara.

faqItems.question: Adakah harga SIM Shopee rendah bermaksud pelan data sudah termasuk?
faqItems.answer: Tidak semestinya. Snapshot listing pada 11 Julai 2026 merekodkan Eastel RM9.96, BeONE RM0.10 dan Halo RM4.96. Itu harga listing marketplace, bukan bukti reload, pelan aktif, kuota data atau hotspot sudah disertakan.

translations.body:
## Pendedahan affiliate
Sesetengah pautan di halaman ini mungkin pautan affiliate. Jika anda membeli melalui pautan tersebut, kami mungkin menerima komisen tanpa kos tambahan kepada anda. Kami hanya menyenaraikan produk yang sesuai dengan kriteria perbandingan halaman ini.

## Had bukti
Ini perbandingan dokumen bagi pelan, hotspot, fair use, pengaktifan dan tempoh sah yang diterbitkan. Kami tidak menjalankan ujian rangkaian hands-on dan tidak mendakwa liputan, kelajuan, latency, signal indoor, kebolehpercayaan atau kesesuaian sebagai pengganti broadband rumah.

## Kesimpulan
Pilih pelan bernama hanya selepas mengesahkan kuota hotspot, tempoh sah dan peraturan selepas kuota. Jangan andaikan faedah daripada harga starter SIM atau tajuk marketplace.

translations.title: 马来西亚移动热点备用指南：Eastel、BeONE 与 Halo
translations.metaTitle: 马来西亚移动热点备用：Eastel、BeONE 与 Halo
translations.metaDescription: 比较 Eastel、BeONE 与 Halo 已公布的套餐、热点、FUP 和有效期规则，用于马来西亚临时移动热点备用。购买前核对实时套餐。
translations.disclosure: 本页部分链接可能是联盟营销链接。如果你通过这些链接购买，我们可能会获得佣金，但你不需要支付额外费用。我们只收录符合本页比较标准的产品。
translations.quickAnswer: 若只是偶尔需要热点备用，应先把套餐同备用时长对应。Eastel 公布了按套餐划分的热点额度，例如 EZ35 在 30 天内有 100GB 热点。BeONE 对所列套餐公布独立热点额度，以及主数据用尽后 512kbps 的规则。所查 Halo 文字条款没有公布可对照的数值热点额度或限额后速度。任何一个都不能被当成可靠覆盖承诺或家庭宽带替代品。
keyTakeaways: 比较明确的有效套餐，不要只看低价 starter SIM。
Eastel 和 BeONE 对特定套餐公布数值热点规则；Halo 需按具体套餐取得书面确认。
套餐有效期、号码有效期和用量耗尽后的规则要分开核对。
宿主网络说法或覆盖地图只供参考，不保证表现。

sections.sectionTitle: 本指南的范围
sections.sectionBody: 这是以公开文件为基础的偶尔移动热点备用指南，例如固定线路故障等待处理期间的临时连接。本文不评价 Eastel、BeONE 或 Halo 的覆盖、速度、延迟、游戏、视频通话、室内信号或稳定性。移动服务会受地点、拥塞、设备、套餐处理和当地环境影响。不要因为假定它能代替家庭宽带而购买这些 SIM。

sections.sectionTitle: 已公布的套餐与热点对比
sections.sectionBody: Eastel 列出 EZ15：RM15、15 天 30GB；EZ35：RM35、30 天 200GB 加 100GB 热点；EZ50、EZ68 和 EZ98 则标示为 30 天 full hotspot。BeONE 的 FUP 表列出 ULTRA plus 25 为 100GB 主数据加 10GB 热点，ULTRA plus 35 为 200GB 加 50GB 热点，也列出每日 3GB 和每周 15GB 选项。Halo 的 EPIK 卡以图片展示，但所查文字条款没有给出可对照的数值热点额度、限额后速度或 FUP 门槛。付款前请在官方 App 或页面核对具体套餐名称。

sections.sectionTitle: Eastel：已公布额度与月套餐规则
sections.sectionBody: Eastel 表示自己是使用 U Mobile 基础设施的 MVNO。若需要明确的 30 天热点额度，EZ35 列为 200GB 主数据和 100GB 热点。EZ50、EZ68 和 EZ98 标示为 full-hotspot 月套餐，但当前套餐页才是最终依据。Eastel 说明 EZ35、EZ50、EZ68、EZ98 同时只能有一个生效；购买新的月套餐会失去旧套餐剩余权益。其一般数据 FUP 允许降速、限制、热点限制、暂停或终止等措施，但没有公布统一的限额后速度。

sections.sectionTitle: BeONE：独立热点额度与限额后处理
sections.sectionBody: BeONE 称服务由 Maxis 驱动；这不代表与 Maxis 零售套餐拥有同样的优先级、覆盖或表现。其 FUP 表提供了明确数字：ULTRA plus 25 为 100GB 主数据和 10GB 热点，ULTRA plus 35 为 200GB 主数据和 50GB 热点。表中写明主数据用完后为 512kbps，独立热点额度用尽后 tethering 可能受限。无限通话的 FUP 为每月 2,000 分钟，之后按标准按量费用计。套餐菜单可能变化，必须核对准确名称。

sections.sectionTitle: Halo：激活与有效期比热点数字更清楚
sections.sectionBody: Halo 条款说明移动服务由 Tune Talk 提供，并与 Winner Venture 联名。已注册 SIM 必须在马来西亚于 14 天内通过充值、通话或短信激活。所查文字条款说明服务受 fair use 约束，过量使用可能被管理、按现行费率收费、暂停或终止，但没有为 EPIK 卡公布数值热点额度、FUP 门槛或限额后速度。不要把 full hotspot 商品标题或 RM4.96 的 starter 价格当成备用额度的证据。充值有效期结束后，Halo 文件说明有 45 天只能接听电话和接收短信的宽限期。

sections.sectionTitle: 激活、有效期与结账检查
sections.sectionBody: 必须实名注册。Eastel 要求注册和验证成功后才可激活，并禁止预激活 SIM。BeONE 也要求身份验证和 SIM 注册，但所查公开一般条款未逐项列出所有证件或开户步骤，应在官方 App 或客服处确认。Halo 对马来西亚公民要求 NRIC，每个 NRIC 或护照最多五张 SIM，并有 14 天马来西亚激活规则。应确认买的是空白 starter SIM 还是指定套餐组合，再核对充值、数据和热点额度、套餐和号码有效期、续订、FUP、卖家及实名后的退款限制。

## 方法与证据
我们查阅了所提供的 Shopee Malaysia 商品页资料，以及在能够确认准确产品或运营商时附带的主要来源。Eastel 表示自己是使用 U Mobile 基础设施的 MVNO。已发布的配套包括 RM15 的 EZ15（15 天 30GB）、RM35 的 EZ35（30 天 200GB 加 100GB 热点）以及 EZ50/68/98 月配套。激活前必须完成注册和验证；RM9.96 的平台价格记录并不表示含有配套或充值额。 BeONE 表示自己由 Maxis 支持，但这并不证明与 Maxis 零售配套拥有相同优先级或表现。其 FUP 表列出每日 3GB、每周 15GB、ULTRA plus 25 的 100GB 加 10GB 热点，以及 ULTRA plus 35 的 200GB 加 50GB 热点；主流量用尽后标示为 512kbps。请在应用或商品页核对所选配套名称。 Halo 条款说明移动服务由 Tune Talk 以与 Winner Venture 联名的方式提供。已注册 SIM 必须在马来西亚于 14 天内通过充值、通话或短信激活。文字条款没有为图片式 EPIK 卡公布数值热点额度、限额后速度或 FUP 门槛，因此不要从商品标题或 RM4.96 价格记录推断这些信息。

## 本文限制
我们没有进行亲手测试，因此不会声称测得性能、可靠性、网络覆盖、续航、降温效果、音频效果或保修结果。商品页快照不代表固定价格、一定包含的配套、授权卖家或完整规格。

## 结论
针对购买新的预付 SIM 卡，把本页当作结账检查清单。购买前请把实时版本与价格同你的真实需求比较。
